thread:
Maya: heads up — we keep seeing orgs with lots of streaming conn spikes bypass per-key token buckets; streaming clients hold open sockets and hammer with tiny chunks
Jordan: hmm, are they using chunked streaming or WebSocket? any logs? :thinking:
Maya: chunked http streaming mostly, (>200 active concurrently for one key). logs show per-request token accounting only on messages, not connection-level
Sasha: that's expected — current limiter is per-request token_bucket, so long-lived connections can send many small requests each under limit
Liam: proposal: attach a connection-level bucket created at stream start with capacity = burst_per_key and refill = per_key_rate
Jordan: +1. Also need endpoint-specific caps: streaming should consume a separate "streaming_tokens" pool; embeddings should use "heavy_tokens" with dims multiplier
Maya: sketch config:
```json
{"limiters": [{"type":"per_key", "rate":1000, "burst":300},{"type":"per_connection", "rate":100, "burst":50, "endpoints":["stream","chat"]}]}
```
Sasha: love it. For rerank set rate very high but very small token cost per call. For embeddings, do per-org aggregate cap because customers generate lots of parallel embed requests
ops-guardian: must be telemetry-first — we need new metrics: conn_active_per_org, conn_token_use, endpoint_token_breakdown, sampled_request_traces
Jordan: dashboard ideas: show active streams per org, sliding window burst usage, and an "enforcement state" toggle with rollout % in console
Maya: rollout UX: feature flag per-org + canary by org size and churn. default to monitor-only mode for 2 days before hard-enforce
Liam: how to handle clients mid-stream when we hard-enforce? options: send 429 and close connection; or slow down chunks (throttle) and emit warning events
Sasha: prefer graceful degradation: send warning frame then throttled chunks, then 429 if persist. Documented in API changelog
quota-bot: rule_applied: per_connection limiter enabled for endpoint=stream for 50% of orgs at 2026-06-01T00:00Z
Maya: perf note: implementing conn-level buckets at edge (nginx layer) is tricky with multi-node; prefer enforcement in runtime where we have KV cache for connection state
Jordan: we can store per-conn bucket in local memory + replicate token spend to central telemetry asynchronously; accept small inconsistencies
Liam: need alerting: spike in 429_streaming_conns, increase in avg_chunk_latency, rise in uncaptured_token_errors
Sasha: also add label "endpoint_class" to metrics so queries can differentiate chat vs streaming vs embeddings for billing
Maya: final ask: eng-platform to ship a minimal PoC: conn-bucket enforced on stream, monitor UI tile, telemetry events. Can we get an ETA? :calendar:
Jordan: I'll take PoC. estimate 2 weeks for runtime + 1 week for dashboard & rollout flag
Liam: I'll help with alerting and ops playbook
Sasha: I'll add docs + changelog
Maya: thanks team :raised_hands:
quota-bot: deployment_note: canary rollout started for 100 orgs at 1801239950
